parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs aliased as compound_chembl_id and canonical SMILES from compound_structures. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, and assays to target_dictionary on tid. Inner join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno. Filter where target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1963'. Return distinct rows sorted by compound_chembl_id.
